blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal.

items.t: Panorama Ridge has no stand-alone City boundary; it sits inside Surrey's South Newton plan area, north of Highway 10, east of King George Boulevard and west of 152 Street.
Its named commercial node is Panorama Heights, at 152 Street and Highway 10, at the area's southeast corner.

blocks.text: Panorama Ridge: rules that affect buyers

items.t: Creek-side lots carry riparian rules because Archibald Creek headwaters, Sullivan Heights Creek and Hyland Creek tributaries run through the plan area.

blocks.text: Panorama Ridge: local details a buyer would not know

items.t: The test address run in earlier research, 13220 64 Avenue, returned North Ridge Elementary and École Panorama Ridge in the district locator — not the elementary school physically closest to it — so catchment cannot be guessed from distance.
No library or recreation centre inside the sub-area was confirmed; Newton Athletic Park, 7395 128 Street, west of the area, is the major sports park serving it.
Surrey-Newton Urgent and Primary Care Centre, 6830 King George Boulevard, is the named urgent-care site serving this part of Newton.

blocks.text: Panorama Ridge: development and new projects

items.t: Amson Bloc, 5937 144 Street, Amson Group, condominiums, one- to three-bedroom homes: the developer states Phase 1 homes arrive Summer 2026 and a Phase 2 release is selling, with project years shown as 2026 and 2027 — status: presale open / under construction (as of November 3, 2026).

A City-endorsed South Newton update added land-use and road-network changes, including density uplift along Colebrook Road, before the plan itself was rescinded into the Surrey 2050 Official Community Plan — status: plan superseded (as of November 3, 2026).

Buses on the 152 Street, 132 Street and 64 Avenue corridors link the ridge to Newton Exchange and Surrey Central; routes named in TransLink's Surrey schedule are 321, 322 and 324, and the R1 RapidBus runs on King George Boulevard west of the area.
Highway 10 is the east–west route at the south edge, toward Langley and Cloverdale eastbound and Delta westbound.

blocks.text: Panorama Ridge: risks and due diligence

items.t: Check riparian setbacks first on any creek-side lot: Archibald Creek headwaters, Sullivan Heights Creek and Hyland Creek tributaries are fish-bearing, and setbacks can shrink the building envelope; the plan page names the creeks, not a lot's setback.
Check whether a south-edge lot sits on the upland side of Highway 10 or toward the Serpentine lowlands before subjects, using City mapping for that lot.

faq.q: Which schools are in Panorama Ridge?
faq.a: Panorama Ridge Secondary, 13220 64 Avenue, and Colebrook Elementary, 5404 125A Street, are in the area, and McLeod Road Traditional, 6325 142 Street, also serves it. Catchment is by home address, not by neighbourhood name, so run the exact address in the School District No. 36 (Surrey) School Locator before relying on any school.

faq.q: What plan governs a rebuild or addition here?
faq.a: The Surrey 2050 Official Community Plan and Zoning Bylaw No. 12000 govern, because the South Newton neighbourhood plan was rescinded in the Official Community Plan update. A seller or neighbour quoting South Newton plan densities is quoting a document that is no longer in effect, so check the current zoning for the lot instead.

faq.q: Can a house here add units?
faq.a: The Panorama-specific point is servicing and creeks: Archibald Creek, Sullivan Heights Creek and Hyland Creek tributaries cross this area, and a creek-side lot can lose building area to riparian setbacks before unit count is even considered.

faq.q: What sits at the south edge of the ridge?
faq.a: Highway 10 and the Serpentine lowlands sit below the south edge, so south-edge lots face a highway corridor rather than houses. The plan area's creeks drain toward those lowlands, which is why drainage and riparian checks matter more on the slope and Colebrook Road side than on the flat top of the ridge.

faq.q: Which schools are in or near Panorama Ridge?
faq.a: École Panorama Ridge Secondary (13220 64 Ave) and Colebrook Elementary (5404 125a St) sit in the area, with McLeod Road Traditional (6325 142 St), North Ridge Elementary (13460 62 Ave) and W E Kinvig Elementary (13266 70b Ave) also serving it — names and addresses confirmed against the BC Ministry K-12 file.

faq.q: What is my child's catchment school in Panorama Ridge?
faq.a: Catchments are address-based in SD36. The one result on record in this program: 13220 64 Ave feeds North Ridge Elementary and École Panorama Ridge Secondary (SD36 School Locator, mybaragar.com, run 2026-11-01). Every other address must be run in the locator itself.

faq.q: What governs land use in Panorama Ridge now?
faq.a: The South Newton plan was rescinded by the Surrey 2050 Official Community Plan update and is no longer in effect, so the OCP and Zoning Bylaw 12000 govern; the plan area the City describes covers lands north of Highway 10, east of King George Boulevard and west of 152 Street.
